newsitem.title: USA: Physician Reliance backs '97 EPS view.
newsitem.headline: Physician Reliance backs '97 EPS view.

text.p: Physician Reliance Network Inc chief executive Mike Reese said the company is comfortable with a 1997 earnings estimate of $0.43 a share, compared to earnings of $0.43 in 1996.

"With what we see in the third and fourth quarters, $0.43 seems like a reasonable number," Reese told Reuters Thursday in an interview following remarks to investors at a Piper Jaffray conference here.
Physician Reliance is one of the largest U.S. physician practice management firms and specializes in managing cancer treatment centers.
Its shares hit a high of $27.50 last summer, but have been beaten down since then due to earnings that were below expectations and investor fear of operating under-performance.
Physician Reliance shares were up 1/8 in early Thursday trading at 10-3/8.
In remarks to investors, Reese said a new chief financial officer has been hired and internal improvements are underway.

"Our company is at that painful time when we are going from an entrepreneurial company to an operational company, and we still have infrastructure build-out to do...the real benefit of this will come in 1998," Reese said.
